scripts.build: npm run build -w @rivexmp/protocol && npm run build -w @rivexmp/sdk-js && npm run build -w @rivexmp/control-api && npm run build -w @rivexmp/console && npm run build -w @rivexmp/launcher
scripts.test: npm run build -w @rivexmp/protocol && npm run build -w @rivexmp/sdk-js && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && npm run test -w @rivexmp/control-api
